verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents a speech-to-text convert endpoint for transcribing an audio or video file, with HTTP API and official SDK support. Accepted formats are only described loosely on the marketing page as "any format — MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV, and more", and no file size or duration limits appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: published file size/duration limits, an exhaustive accepted-format list in the API reference, and hands-on corroboration of local file upload.
